Use the full Muse Spark 1.3 token budget. Perform an adversarial integration audit of tire forces from wheel kinematics through TireModel to rigid-body application. User reports the tires feel rock-hard with no grip. Look for coordinate transforms, slip-angle sign/magnitude errors, wrong contact velocities, force-frame rotation mistakes, surface friction scaling, force application points, load inputs, or driven-wheel dynamics that could make apparently reasonable tire curves produce weak cornering in the actual car. Respect AGENTS.md and PHYSICS_CONVENTIONS.md: do not tune around a sign/integration defect. Inspect Vehicle.ts, WheelDynamics.ts, TireModel.ts, SurfaceProvider.ts, Simulation.ts, convention tests and cornering diagnostics. Add mirrored deterministic regression coverage for any defect and require strict M5 validation.
